name: How do I choose a contractor for stucco re-flashing?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for stucco re-flashing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for stucco re-flashing, look for professionals with extensive experience specifically in stucco remediation and flashing. Verify that they are licensed and insured, and ask for references from previous clients with similar projects. A reputable contractor will conduct a thorough on-site inspection, provide a detailed written estimate, and clearly explain the scope of work, materials, and warranty. Prioritize contractors who demonstrate a strong understanding of local building codes and best practices for water management in stucco systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a stucco re-flashing contractor based on their experience, licensing, insurance, references, and a detailed estimate outlining their process and warranty.
